PluginData.Author: lolifamily
PluginData.Tooltip: True HDR output: fp16 scRGB swapchain, BT.2390 tonemapping, separate UI brightness, emissive particle boost, EXR screenshots
PluginData.Description: Adds a true HDR output path to Space Engineers 2 (DX12). The swapchain becomes flip-model R16G16B16A16_Float with scRGB color space. A BT.2390 display mapping (PQ space) replaces the engine's SDR tonemapping: the original shadows and midtones sit at a configurable scene paper white, highlights extend up to the display peak. The UI is composited from its own layer at its own brightness, so SDR menus and HUD read correctly on an HDR display. Emissive GPU particles (thrusters, lasers, muzzle flashes, explosions) can be boosted with live preview; smoke and dust are untouched. Screenshots are also exported as OpenEXR (HDR) beside the game's normal SDR image. Use FSR for anti-aliasing in HDR; FXAA only reaches the SDR copy used for thumbnails. Rec.709 primaries, hue-preserving mapping; no wide-gamut remap. Auto-disables itself if it crashes during init, with a config flag to re-enable. Requires Windows HDR enabled and a supported display; can be force-enabled on SDR displays.
